# bioexcel/biobb_chemistry/acpype_params_gmx

## Summary

This class is a wrapper of Acpype tool for generation of topologies for GROMACS.

Generation of topologies for GROMACS. Acpype is a tool based in Python to use Antechamber to generate topologies for chemical compounds and to interface with others python applications like CCPN or ARIA. Visit the official page.

Nextflow adapter of the [AcpypeParamsGMX](https://biobb-chemistry.readthedocs.io/en/latest/acpype.html#module-acpype.acpype_params_gmx) building block of [biobb_chemistry](https://github.com/bioexcel/biobb_chemistry) 5.3.0.

## Get started

```nextflow
include { BIOBB_CHEMISTRY_ACPYPE_PARAMS_GMX } from 'bioexcel/biobb_chemistry/acpype_params_gmx'

workflow {
    BIOBB_CHEMISTRY_ACPYPE_PARAMS_GMX(ch_input)
}
```

Optional input files are passed as `[]`.

## Inputs

| Name | Required | Formats | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | yes | | Map with at least an `id` key, used as tag and output file prefix |
| `input_path` | yes | pdb, mdl, mol2 | Path to the input file |

## Outputs

Each output channel emits `[meta, file]`. Files are named `<prefix>_<role>.<extension>`, where role is the output argument without `output_` and `_path`.
Optional outputs are only produced if requested in `ext.outputs`.

| Channel | Required | Formats (default first) | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `output_path_gro` | yes | gro | Path to the GRO output file |
| `output_path_itp` | yes | itp | Path to the ITP output file |
| `output_path_top` | yes | top | Path to the TOP output file |
| `versions_biobb_chemistry` | yes | | `[process, 'biobb_chemistry', version]`, also sent to the `versions` topic |

## Configuration

Set with `ext` in a `process` `withName` selector:

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `ext.properties` | Map of AcpypeParamsGMX properties (see below). Defaults: `[can_write_file_log: false]` |
| `ext.outputs` | Map of output argument to extension, for example `[output_path_gro: 'gro']`. Required outputs use their first format by default; optional outputs are only requested when listed here |
| `ext.prefix` | Output file prefix (default: `meta.id`) |

`raise_error` and `restart` are always set by the adapter: failed commands fail the task, and `-resume` replaces restart.
Do not set the `container_*` properties: Nextflow runs the task inside the biobb_chemistry container.

```groovy
process {
    withName: 'BIOBB_CHEMISTRY_ACPYPE_PARAMS_GMX' {
        ext.properties = [basename: 'BBB']
    }
}
```

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `basename` | string | "BBB" | A basename for the project (folder and output files). |
| `charge` | integer | 0 | Net molecular charge, for gas default is 0. If None the charge is guessed by acpype. |
| `binary_path` | string | "acpype" | Path to the acpype executable binary. |
| `remove_tmp` | boolean | true | Remove temporal files. |
| `sandbox_path` | string | "./" | Parent path to the sandbox directory. |
